column1: # Generated by `lake exe oracle` (spec/Oracle.lean) from the definition in
# spec/Aontu: every value of the fragment up to one meet (600) against 16
# instances, as `verdict` rows whose expectation is the verdict `check`
# gives, which `check_iff` makes the definition's own. Until P5 the
# definition gives admission only, so a refusal is written as the three
# classes it may be. Regenerate with `make spec`; never edit by hand. The
# cases the ports do not yet answer this way are listed in spec/ledger.tsv.
